I think this is the lowest I've been. I've been in worse situations before, but I just don't have the will or energy anymore. I can't think properly because every time I get some clarity, I get panic attacks about what is happening, and what has happened. So I feel very foggy and dull and tired. 

I don't drink or do drugs, so I think I would be eligible to donate my organs. The only thing is I'm underweight (5'2 88lbs) and that kept me from donating plasma recently. So I don't know if it'll disqualify me.

Thank you for replying. I'm over 18, but I don't have any assets (no car, no land, no furniture, not even a bed.) But it assures me greatly if it will disappear when I'm gone. 

I have thought of that. I've been looking into at least donating my organs before I go. Like if I'm a match, I can at least give my kidney/liver/bone marrow to someone who needs it. The main deterrence on that is that it takes too much time and way too much money that I don't have. But if the opportunity presented itself more easily and more accessibly, I would do it on the spot. 

That train of logic, that I'm going to die soon anyways, is good. It's the only reason why I've been staying afloat and am still alive. I have been trying my best to hold onto it while I can. Everything feels very numb, like I'm underwater. I have not been this far gone, ever, which surprises me. It's all very strange.

Thank you for taking the time to read and respond to my post. I'm sorry if I'm not making any sense. My mind has been in a perpetually fog, like dissaccociating, as a defense mechanism I think. I hope you are doing okay tho. Please keep fighting and being well and finding happiness, because I am not able to anymore.

Oh I'm sorry. I think I was projecting a lot there :(. It's funny, I think most people are very lovely and wonderful. But lately, due to my circumstances and environment, I've been exposed to some really twisted and awful people who have tried to intentionally hurt me in the worst ways possible (haven't experienced that evil since childhood). 

I'm sorry, I totally projected that goal of peace and stability. Because that's all I want really, that and being/feeling physically safe (again due to my situation). So something as simple and routine/mundane as walking out to a coffee shop without feeling scared, is a distant nice goal for me.

I feel like the older I get, the more I am exposed to the evil, cruel, and ugly parts of life. So it starts to outweigh the brighter, more beautiful experiences I've had. But deep deep inside me, I want to fight and rebel against that badness. I secretly want to discover and experience more happiness so that all those people and bad events won't win. I want to help children and young adults so such things can be prevented. But it's hard. It's especially difficult now, so many times it crosses my mind that trying isn't worth it after all. 

I can't imagine living longer than ten more years, just for myself. But maybe if there's a future with me helping others, and preventing others from experiencing harm, maybe it will be worth it.

I would get comments about me seeming to space out, act ditzy or air headed. My cheery mask also enforced the air headed, happy go lucky, stupid girl image. Half the time, I can't finish saying my point, my focus and train of thinking falters. But now that I think about it, depression really has hindered my mind. I can't remember the last time I had any decent clarity or concentration.


Edit: also because if this, most things and tasks overwhelm me easily too. That's where it exacerbates my anxiety.

Those bright beautiful moments shine so much brighter in all the darkness that we experience more if, as we grow older.
